map.不是。音量是简单的振幅增益，响度是人体感知的 loudness（常用 LUFS: No. Volume is simply an amplitude gain, whereas loudness is the perceived loudness of the human ear (commonly measured in LUFS). Doubling the amplitude does not necessarily sound twice as loud. Before distribution, use loudness normalisation (such as -14 LUFS) rather than looking at peak level alone.
map.为什么调大音量后声音破了？: Why does the sound break up after turning the volume up?
map.因为采样值被乘数放大后超过 ±1.0，超出可表示范围被硬削平（削波），产生刺耳失: Because the sample values, once multiplied, exceed +/-1.0, they are hard-clipped beyond the representable range (clipping), producing harsh distortion. Leave enough headroom, use soft clipping or reduce before boosting, and after boosting check that the peak stays below 0 dBFS.

map.：音量调节本质是采样值乘以增益系数 g。若用 dB 表示增益，则 g=10^(d: : volume adjustment is essentially multiplying sample values by a gain factor g. In dB, g = 10^(dB/20); for example +6 dB gives g ~= 1.995 (roughly doubling the amplitude). To normalise to a peak of -1 dBFS: first find the current maximum absolute sample A_max, the target peak is 10^(-1/20) ~= 0.891, so g = 0.891 / A_max. If g is so large that some sample exceeds +/-1.0 it is clipped and distorted, so the peak must be checked after boosting.
